text:
Maya (CS): Quick sync thread from ClearHarbor renewal call — got three product asks and one major pain: onboarding template mismatch and cost surprises. Copying notes below.

Maya (CS): Customer: ClearHarbor. Renewal due in 45 days. Risk: saw a 40% token spike when they turned on per-route logging -> surprised by cost.

Maya (CS): Asks:
• export of per-route usage CSV for finance
• an onboarding checklist that maps to our Console UI (they keep missing 'pin version')
• ability to set per-namespace cost caps / alerts

Jared (PM): thanks, can you paste the exact phrasing they used for the checklist ask? I want to capture job-to-be-done.

Maya (CS): "Our onboarding docs don't line up with the Console — we tell customers to 'pin model version' but the UI shows 'model selector' and non-technical PMs get lost" — said their CSM.

Priya (Product): Noted. This feels like a docs+UX gap. Low effort: add a single-page 'onboarding checklist' in Console + downloadable PDF. Medium: add inline help copy next to model selector. Thoughts?

Sam (Eng): Per-route CSV export is doable but needs auth review; could expose via exports endpoint and S3. ETA ~2 sprints?

Maya (CS): Customer would take CSV now, even if manual. They need finance-friendly columns: date, route, tokens_in, tokens_out, cost_est.

Logan (CS Manager): Tagging as HIGH risk for renewal unless finance visibility fixed. Can we get a short-term workaround? Priya/Jared

Priya (Product): Short-term: we can create an ad-hoc export from the billing dashboard and send weekly until feature shipped. Sam, can eng enable a one-off export this week?

Sam (Eng): I can run a scheduled job to dump last 30 days to internal S3 and share link. Will need owner for retention. ETA: EOD Thu.

cs-bot: Reminder — add 'ClearHarbor export' to #customer-success backlog as P1. (automated)

Jared (PM): Action items:
- Sam: one-off export by EOD Thu
- Maya: send export to customer + check if they accept weekly updates
- Priya: scope onboarding checklist (quick doc + in-console copy) — aim for next sprint
- Product: evaluate cost-capping feature feasibility (low/med/long)

Maya (CS): adding: customer also asked for 'sample prompt templates' that map to our SDKs — they want copy-paste examples for common flows.

Priya (Product): We'll repurpose the quickstart templates. I'll add to the checklist deliverable.

Logan (CS Manager): good. please react :thumbsup: when you own an item so I can follow up at next standup.

Maya (CS): tagging @Sam @Priya @Jared — I'm happy to coordinate the external comms.

Sam (Eng): :thumbsup:

Priya (Product): :thumbsup:

Jared (PM): :thumbsup:

Maya (CS): I'll update the renewal healthboard after we confirm the export.
